parameters.name: visible
parameters.enabled_when: Core Set requires a complete recognized imagejxx.channel-display integer-V1 state, exact C channel count, scalar S1 UInt8/UInt16/Float32 and valid sample policy. The shared panel additionally requires its captured active owner, a recognized supported state, no interpretation error, an idle Window and an apply callback. In one draw at most one state action is dispatched after ImGui scopes close; Close, titlebar close or focused Escape cancels it before callback. Checkbox values are loaded from the captured channel state, whose fresh native default is true; a click copies the complete state and changes only the selected channel visibility.

samples: S1 scalar; scientific C is a separate axis; recognized Float64/RGB/RGBA state is refused
axes: C-indexed Boolean state shared across every Z/T; XY/XZ/YZ consumers
Composite C<=8; strict stored Composite C>8 refuses; explicit requested-state normalization above8 uses Color
targets: Exactly one UI-selected channel flag per checkbox action; no pixel/ROI/stack target mutation
Composite uses visible channels; no visible contributors returns fresh black output with no source plane reads
Color/Grayscale ignore visibility and use active C; singleton Composite uses gray for its sole contributing channel
roi: Full-plane display composition; visibility ignores selections/ROIs without changing them; existing threshold and XY annotation layers remain their own consumed contracts
border: No border sampling, padding, interpolation or geometric transformation; full in-bounds display plane
contract.nonfinite: Range endpoints must be finite and low<=high, including literal equal endpoints. Typed JSON metadata rejects Boolean endpoints and lossy integer-to-double conversion. FiniteOnly source samples must be finite; PreserveQuietNaNFloat32 uses the existing canonical scalar F32 admission, maps admitted quiet NaNs to LUT entry0 and preserves source payloads. Noncanonical finite double storage under an admitted type tag uses the documented owned arithmetic extension, not an inferred upstream match. No type conversion or source writes occur.
contract.geometry: Display-only state is shared over all Z/T for each C; it never edits samples, shape, calibration, selection/previous, saved ROIs/overlays, metadata, pixel history/redo or source data identity. command_display_state preserves current navigation and unrelated/legacy flat display fields. Set resolves metadata-only with no sample/provider reads or user callbacks; complete strict V1 state and action records stay unchanged. Window checks owner and Pixels/Metadata revisions, preflights workflow publication before native display publication, and appends the accepted normalized Set record only when recording is on. Strict replay requires the recorded owner/source metadata; display/selection changes may differ; new-owner use needs explicit full rebind. Native V3 transports recognized state and action records, while detached v2 guards remain. These consumed publication/persistence services retain their own P06c evidence boundary; this registration creates no new acceptance.

default_semantics.ui_initial_value: Current captured state.channels[c].visible, not an unconditional reset to true.
default_semantics.unavailable_state: No scalar checkbox is admitted until supported recognized state is enabled.

ui_semantics.label: C followed by one-based C
ui_semantics.submit: A checkbox release queues Set; pending state action disables subsequent state actions in the same frame. Close, titlebar close or focused Escape can cancel that action before callback.
ui_semantics.active_channel_effect: None; retain current T/C/Z. Separate Active channel combo owns navigation.

Calibrated Set/propagation, GUI Auto and destructive Apply remain adjacent CD16/CD13/CD26 work.

reference.scope: `CompositeImage.setDisplayRange`/LUT setters/getters: ranges are channel display state shared across Z/T, not per-plane pixel edits. Integer processor endpoint conversion and F32 endpoint storage differ. Changing active-C LUT preserves its range. Owned/native scope and remaining differences: P06c scopes exact requested ranges, effective-range consumers, quiet-NaN mapping and source/history preservation. Keep intensity calibration (CD16) separate from spatial calibration, and retain legacy flat fields when recognized state is disabled. Registered scalar boundary: UI fields initialize from the current captured state, accept complete finite raw numbers with low<=high, retain invalid drafts, and submit only on explicit Apply. Native ChannelDisplayChannel default range[0,255] is an initializer, not a universal image-dependent GUI/reset range or an upstream default for every dtype. Equal requested ranges remain literal under the owned P06c policy; upstream setMinAndMax(0,0) reset semantics are not claimed.

Noncanonical finite double storage under an admitted type tag uses the documented owned arithmetic extension, not an inferred upstream match. No type conversion or source writes occur.

Native V3 transports recognized state and action records, while detached v2 guards remain. These consumed publication/persistence services retain their own P06c evidence boundary; this registration creates no new acceptance. Requested finite endpoint doubles persist unchanged. U8 maps from rounded low origin using original requested width without a rounded-high shortcut; U16 rounds both endpoints with denominator+1; F32 uses binary32-rounded endpoints when finite-representable, otherwise the owned raw-double extension. default_semantics.ui_initial_value: Current captured state.channels[display.c].range; no fixed universal GUI default.
default_semantics.fresh_enable: Existing P06c explicit first-enable inheritance/default reset policy supplies the state before these controls; its image-dependent defaults are not replaced.
default_semantics.public_set: A complete admitted state is required; neither C++ resolve nor Python action=set fills omitted ranges from these parameter defaults.

ui_semantics.parser: Trim only space, tab, CR and LF, allow a single leading plus, parse complete general-format finite double; reject trailing text, nonfinite values and reversed endpoints.
ui_semantics.draft: Text is retained while the same owner/C/source range remains; invalid drafts remain visible and Apply disabled. Unrelated state updates do not discard it. Owner/C/source-range changes rebase; successful range Apply/Reset forces next-frame rebase.
ui_semantics.submit: Only explicit Apply, after scopes close; at most one state action per draw unless panel dismissal cancels it before callback; fields reflect captured current C.
ui_semantics.reset_distinction: Separate Reset current/all range actions; neither [0,0] nor other equal ranges request Reset or GUI Auto.
